method.semantic_step: Per-group re-read of the recalling Markdown sources plus a full six-book keyword pass for every entity. Every quoted sentence was re-opened at its source line before the unit was finalized; two draft quotes were corrected in this pass (中山陵 条例原文、人民大会堂 周恩来分包句).
method.canonical_rule: One canonical candidate per group is promoted to a knowledge unit; every other same-entity candidate, including title variants outside the duplicate group, is set to rejected with target_ref pointing at the new unit. Canonical was chosen for coverage, not seniority: 嵩岳寺塔, 布达拉宫 and 赵州桥 take the 赵农 candidate because it carries the structural or historical detail the other two books omit.
method.source_count_correction: The recall group's doc_count is a nominal count. Re-reading all six books changed one of seven: 嵩岳寺塔 3→4 (李立新, via the title-variant candidate 北魏嵩岳寺塔). The other six stayed at 3; 高丰、田自秉 two books contain no material on these buildings, and 高丰's 布达拉宫 mural sentence is a bronze-mirror datum, not an architectural source, so it was excluded.
method.title_variant_rule: One open work candidate filed under a different title (北魏嵩岳寺塔) was checked against the canonical span before being rejected as a duplicate. 2009-zhaonong-zhongguo-yishu-shejishi:cand-11-173 “重庆人民大会堂” is a different building (赵农 L7813, regional architecture list) and stays open; it was not merged.
method.exclusion_rule: Bare-name hits that are not the entity were excluded: 赵农 L7813 “重庆人民大会堂” is another building; 赵农 L4295 小雁塔 is another site; 夏燕靖两版 the 札什伦布寺 figure captions sit in the same figure group as 布达拉宫 but are another building; 高丰 L2998 “布达拉宫唐代壁画” is a mirror-history datum.
method.quote_boundary_rule: Quotations record the exact source line and keep the source's own wording, including its errors: 夏燕靖 “中央人民政府” in 1958; “中国建筑志家／中国建筑志研究学家” for 莫宗江; “阁楼式” vs “楼阁式”; “窨（yìn）” vs “窖（xūn）”; “敞肩拱” vs “敞肩型”.
method.filename_rule: Year suffixes follow taxonomy.md: exact year when the sources agree (dayan-ta-652, songyue-si-ta-523, guohui-1950, zhongshan-ling-1929, renmin-dahuitang-1959); a range when the sources give a design-build span (zhaozhou-qiao-595-605); no suffix when there is no single build year (budala-gong: 7th-century founding, 8th-century destruction, early-Qing reconstruction).
method.relation_update_rule: No existing unit was modified. Cross-references to other units appear only in 相关知识元 as non-assertive mentions; no formal relations were written.
method.state_honesty: All seven units are confidence=medium, consensus=tentative, evidence_status=source_backed; no verification_level is set and no unit is marked confirmed.

source_variance_notes.variance: 另一设计组的机构名：2009 同段先作“国立北平艺专”、后作“中央美术学院”，2016 统一作“中央美术学院”；“命令公布”（2009）与“签署命令正式发布”（2016）措辞不同；赵农只给图 10-5 与一句总评，无过程。
征图 1927 年（夏燕靖两版）与设计 1929 年（赵农），两册都不标动工—建成阶段；钟形释义“木铎警世”（夏燕靖两版引评判报告）与“晨钟暮鼓”（赵农）。
夏燕靖两版近乎逐字相同，给组织过程与室内设计；赵农只给“十大建筑”框架、清华学派与图 10-46 华灯。两版图题归类不同（人民大会堂／北京十大建筑）。无尺寸、座位、高度、结构数据。
总高 64.1 米（夏燕靖两版）与 64 米（赵农）；“始建于隋代”与“大雁塔建于永徽三年”同段并存而所指不明；“楼阁式”与“阁楼式”用字不同；寺名缘起一作“扩建为寺院、更名”，一作“因高宗纪念其母而称”。
高度 41 米（夏燕靖两版）与 39.5 米（赵农）；类型“15 层密檐楼阁式砖塔”（夏燕靖两版）与“15 层密檐式结构砖塔”（赵农）；“窨（yìn）水”（2016）与“窖（xūn）水”（2009）；图题“魏晋南北朝”（2009）不专作“北魏”。
始建 7 世纪（夏燕靖两版）与 6—7 世纪且 8 世纪后被毁（赵农）；高度 115 米与 115.7 米；结构“石木”与“土木石”；“镏金”与“鎏金”。
年代 595～605 年（夏燕靖两版）与 605 年（赵农）；长度 50 余米与 52.82 米、跨度 37 米多与 37.4 米；类型“双曲石拱桥”与“单孔式／扁弧形弓式”；耐久 1300 多年与 1400 多年。
